notes.title: Character Intros: Sharky Shark 🦈
notes.content:
Hello there fellow AbomiFighters!

It's high time to start presenting our colorful menagerie of characters that will be playable - each comes with their own quirks, advantages and hopefully, prove very fun to play around with!

*drums roll*


🦈 Sharky Shark! 🦈


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977103/16ffd4372da4da596bd1f4a7e5d26c067bbccdda.png

Nimble, blue, and a deadly accurate biter! As you may rememember from the masterpiece that Jaws truly was, you will be able to descend into the abyss of the map and resurface, startling your opponents, and hopefully, snagging a tasty limb or two off them!

[previewyoutube=qCzncv0ISaE;full][/previewyoutube]

The special attack works only on the flat plane, as the ocean cannot climb horizontally yet (we know, tsunamis don't count here!), and whenever there are additional characters on the map, the closest one gets grabbed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977103/c15d4d14bf9ddcb9199c992daefefc28f76c7665.jpg


Come a'hunting with us!
Proud Turkeys

notes.title: 🐉 Racing to Digital Dragons 2024
notes.content:
Hello there fellow Fighters!

We are exited to keep Abomifighters showcase going - following our recent trips to DevGamm Gdansk and Indie Game Arena, we are gracing Digital Dragons with our over the top claymation arcade fighter between May 19th - 22nd!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977103/ed388def378b241ac170d777ac37c3d1637ae55c.jpg

Feel free to reach us in case you'd like to see the progress of our game, ask us about mechanics, have a fight together, or simply talk business. And of course, learn why fighting is now way more important than racing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977103/e15f32af60050f0a91d1df3e9bc99f534e06b743.png

See you all very soon in Cracow!

With love,
Proud Turkeys

notes.title: 🔥 We are very much alive and kicking!
notes.content:
Hello there fellow AbomiFighters!

We are coming back from the dead! The game is still being developed, and we are very excited to start sharing more of the journey with you over the coming months!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977103/fe097f2473733ad8110a4c98724490dd9bd9bedb.gif

From explaining where the idea came from, sharing our inspirations as game designers, and finally, showing how the game shapes up after the changes to the genre, and so much more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977103/3ffa9db050481027dcaaf4b526fcfb0a390ffd82.jpg

Currently, as you have probably seen, we’ve implemented the name change from Abomiracers to AbomiFIGHTERS – our current plan for the game is to focus on fighting rather than racing. You will still be able to do it, although instead of a track, you will be set up onto a fighting ring and arena, and be able to run in circles to avoid being hit. Sounds cozy indeed, right?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41977103/8b4057bc90baef60fe274a3b8afef93df4ed4b02.jpg

Let's take a treck from the old vision and its trailer:
[previewyoutube=pYwEWb2wmpA;full][/previewyoutube]

🔥 To the improved gameplay, concept, and more fun! 🔥
[previewyoutube=TVhtCAYe6Hw;full][/previewyoutube]

We are currently building up our new way of working and sharing news with you all – so get ready, and get punchy!

🎉 We have a new trailer in the works, too! 🎉



With love,
Proud Turkeys
